context_for_next_testing_agent: Medical Records module fully functional. Key features: collapsible form sections using Radix UI Collapsible, vital signs with out-of-range alerts (VITAL_RANGES constant), auto BMI calculation, ICD10 search with debounce, draft/finalize workflow, addendum for finalized records. Backend endpoints: POST/GET/PUT /api/clinic/medical-records, GET /api/clinic/patients/:id/medical-records, POST /api/clinic/medical-records/:id/addendum, GET /api/clinic/icd10/search. Fixed bug: oxygen_saturation was being passed as float but DB expects integer.

bug_fix_applied.issue: oxygen_saturation field was causing 500 error when creating medical records with SpO2 values
bug_fix_applied.root_cause: Pydantic model accepts float but Supabase DB column is integer type
bug_fix_applied.fix: Added int() conversion for oxygen_saturation in create and update endpoints
